verdict.rationale: USCIS's own homepage lists "Check processing times" among its first-party online tools, so the service does publish processing-time information. The evidence is only a single link-level mention, with nothing showing what the times cover or how current they are. Missing for 10: evidence that times are broken out per form or transaction type, evidence of how current or how often updated the published times are, any documentation of the processing-times tool itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself

citations.quote: Use our online tools and resources to manage your case: Check your case status; Check processing times; Change your address online
